'''Blair Beveridge''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 110 from Toronto, On. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Born in Toronto in March 1975, he played from the game's release and ran the Echobase Ops website for the Hoth: Ice Plains region.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
